name: Hahaoya Saimin Nikki ~Otto no Inai Aida ni...~
original_name: 母親催眠日記 ～夫のいない間に……～
source:
The mother is a well-behaved, modest, and chaste woman.  However, since her husband is often away on business, the protagonist accidentally observes her masturbating. 

He uses hypnosis on his mother, and succeeds in depriving her of her freedom. 

"I'm going to tell your father!"

The mother is so fretful, but as the protagonist caresses her and uses sex toys on her, she gradually begins to let out a seductive moan.

[From [url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/bh/bihf004/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
母亲是个品行端正、端庄贞洁的女人。然而，由于丈夫经常出差，主角偶然撞见她自慰。

他对母亲施加催眠，成功夺走了她的自由。

“我要告诉你爸爸！”

母亲焦躁不安，可当主角抚摸她、对她使用情趣玩具时，她渐渐发出了诱人的呻吟。

[来自[url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/bh/bihf004/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
